name: ask-canada
description: Ask Canada — an AI-first front door to government services. Open source; any country can run it.

paragraphs: Every federal service, in plain language. Ask a question in English or French (or 20 other languages) and get a clear answer with the official source, plus planners, calculators, checklists and live data rendered right inside the conversation. When it's time to sign in, apply or pay, Ask Canada hands you off to the official page.

Ask Canada is an independent, open-source service built on official Government of Canada sources, and it is built to Government of Canada web standards so the Government could adopt it as-is. The core is country-agnostic: Canada is the first country pack.
AI SDK v7 (ai, @ai-sdk/react, @ai-sdk/anthropic, @ai-sdk/gateway), streamdown, motion, zod.
features: Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind CSS v4,
